scope.question: Is the confirmed TSS polarity effect explained by the target-minus-control GC/CpG composition differential, or does it survive at matched composition?
scope.licensed_if_qualified: that the target-minus-control GC/CpG composition differential does not account for the replicated TSS polarity in mask sensitivity
explicitly_excluded: a bounded downstream domain or any distal edge - REFUTED by D12
exclusion of compositional features other than GC and CpG

supply.source_definition_change: GENCODE v50 protein-coding TSSs including non-MANE-Select transcripts, restricted to 1-Mb blocks unused by D4 and D7-D12
supply.yield_basis: Controller pre-flight on the 384-pair promoter_source_localization_v1 cohort, model-free: 371/384 loci admit covers on both sides; of those, 230 (62%) admit a matched pair at GC 0.05 / CpG 0.03, 224 admit BOTH arms, and 363 (98%) admit an unmatched arm at 0.20 separation. The cohort must therefore over-provision raw pairs to land 120 matched per split.

regions.boundary: These are the two regions whose contrast D12 confirmed. They are NOT a claim that the downstream region is bounded; D12 refuted the edge.

matching.delta_definition: for one BPE cover: delta_X = X(target cover) - X(control cover), for X in {GC fraction, CpG count per nucleotide}
matching.selection_rule: among all eligible downstream/upstream cover pairs for a locus, choose the pair minimizing abs(delta_GC difference) then abs(delta_CpG difference) then cover-center distance; ties broken by lowest start coordinate

P1_matched_polarity.definition: per locus: target_specific_loss at the matched downstream cover minus target_specific_loss at the matched upstream cover, over pairs inside the tight caliper
P1_matched_polarity.interpretation: meets SESOI with a positive lower bound => composition does not account for the polarity

P2_composition_attributable.definition: per locus: unmatched-arm polarity minus matched-arm polarity, on loci supplying both arms
P2_composition_attributable.interpretation: the component of the polarity attributable to the composition differential

P3_dose_response.definition: OLS slope of per-pair polarity on abs(delta_GC difference), across all eligible pairs
P3_dose_response.interpretation: a flat slope supports position; a steep positive slope supports composition

planted_positive.check: the deliberately unmatched arm (GC separation at least 0.20) must produce a larger polarity than the matched arm on the same loci, by at least the P2 SESOI, on reserved GUE data
planted_positive.rationale: this study's primary claim is an EXCLUSION. Without demonstrated sensitivity to a composition effect, a null P2 is uninterpretable.

permuted_label_fpr.check: with target/control labels permuted 256 times, the matched-arm polarity center must fall within 0.05 of zero

M1_identity.check: masking zero tokens yields target_specific_loss with maximum absolute value below tolerance
M1_identity.note: NOT architecture-forced: this is a genuine no-op of the same token-substitution path the endpoints use, unlike D12's M1 which was a Q/K/V identity patch and was largely architecture-forced.

M2_caliper_respected.check: every scored matched pair satisfies both tight calipers; every scored unmatched pair meets the minimum GC separation

M3_equal_dose.check: every scored cover masks exactly 2 genomic tokens on each branch, and target/control cover lengths differ by at most 2 nt

M4_region_containment.check: every downstream cover lies within +1:+31 and every upstream cover within -39:-9, inclusive of partial overlap but with cover center inside the region

development_requires: QUALIFIED preflight including both calibration arms
clean target-minus-control promoter margin at least 0.50 logits with a positive 95% lower bound
split_gate.confirmation_opens_if: P1 qualifies in development AND the planted-positive calibration passed
split_gate.confirmation_uses: unchanged development definitions, calipers, regions, thresholds and seeds

stop_rules: If the planted-positive calibration fails, record INSTRUMENT_UNRESOLVED and open nothing. A null P1 without demonstrated sensitivity licenses no exclusion.
If P1 fails while the planted positive passed, composition is supported as an explanation of the polarity and that must be reported as the finding.
P3 is secondary and never gates confirmation.
No result licenses any statement about a bounded domain or a distal edge; D12 refuted those.
